tools.name: codex
tools.init: _rc_src=/home/agent/rc-codex-placeholder/auth.json; _rc_home="${CODEX_HOME:-/home/agent/.codex}"; if [ -r "$_rc_src" ]; then if mkdir -p "$_rc_home" && cp "$_rc_src" "$_rc_home/auth.json.tmp" && chmod 0600 "$_rc_home/auth.json.tmp" && mv -f "$_rc_home/auth.json.tmp" "$_rc_home/auth.json"; then :; else echo "[rip-cage] WARNING: could not copy the codex placeholder auth.json into ${_rc_home} (codex will fail to log in)" >&2; fi; else echo "[rip-cage] WARNING: no codex placeholder at ${_rc_src} — mount the directory codex-secret.sh writes there :ro (examples/codex/README.md)" >&2; fi; true
